history.text: FAISS 1.8.0 (released October 2023 by Meta) adds multi-GPU support for IndexIVFFlat, a new IndexFlatCosine for built-in vector normalisation, and improved k-means clustering for large GPU datasets. On the ANN-Benchmarks suite, FAISS IndexHNSWFlat reaches recall@10 ≥ 0.99 at 5–8k QPS single-threaded for 768-dim vectors, with GPU variants scaling beyond 1M QPS for billion-scale corpora.

final_answer: FAISS 1.8.0 (released October 2023 by Meta) adds multi-GPU support for IndexIVFFlat, a new IndexFlatCosine for built-in vector normalisation, and improved k-means clustering for large GPU datasets.
